items.q: Which sentence is the most suitable opening for a written summary of an article about recycling programs?
o: I really love recycling and do it every weekend with my whole family.
Recycling is the best thing in the world, so everyone must always do it.
The article explains why recycling programs fail and how to fix them.
Yesterday I found a very long article about something I had never heard of.
items.why: 요약문은 글의 주제를 객관적으로 소개하는 문장으로 시작해야 해요.

items.good: Not only does the report describe the problem, but it also suggests solutions.
items.ko: 그 보고서는 문제를 설명할 뿐만 아니라 해결책도 제시한다.
bad: Not only the report describes the problem, but it also suggests solutions.
Not only does the report describes the problem, but it also suggests solutions.
Not only does the report describe the problem, and it also suggests solutions.

cz.st: Not only ___ the report describe the problem, but it also suggests solutions.

items.rule: Not only가 문장 앞에 오면 주어와 동사가 도치되어 does the report describe가 돼요. 짝은 but ... also예요.
items.hint: Not only로 문장을 시작하면 어순이 바뀌어요.

items.good: The first study focused on teenagers, whereas the second studied adults.
items.ko: 첫 번째 연구는 십 대에 초점을 두었지만, 두 번째 연구는 성인을 연구했다.
bad: The first study focused on teenagers, whereas the second studying adults.
The first study focused on teenagers, whereas studied the second adults.
The first study focused on teenagers, whereas the second studies of adults.

cz.st: The first study focused on teenagers, whereas the second ___ adults.

items.rule: whereas 뒤에도 주어와 동사를 갖춘 완전한 절이 와야 해요. 대조하는 두 절의 시제도 맞춰요.

items.good: The article, written by a scientist, explains how bees communicate.
items.ko: 과학자가 쓴 그 기사는 벌이 어떻게 의사소통하는지 설명한다.
bad: The article, wrote by a scientist, explains how bees communicate.
The article, writing by a scientist, explains how bees communicate.
The article, which written by a scientist, explains how bees communicate.

cz.st: The article, ___ by a scientist, explains how bees communicate.

items.rule: 기사는 '쓰여진' 대상이므로 수동의 과거분사 written을 써서 관계절을 줄여요.

items.good: The writer argues that cities should invest in public transport.
items.ko: 필자는 도시가 대중교통에 투자해야 한다고 주장한다.
bad: The writer argues that cities to invest in public transport.
The writer argues that cities should to invest in public transport.
The writer argues that cities should invests in public transport.

cz.st: The writer argues that cities ___ in public transport.

items.rule: 주장을 나타내는 argues that 뒤에는 완전한 절이 오고, 조동사 should 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요.

items.good: The results were published last year, and they surprised many scientists.
items.ko: 그 결과는 작년에 발표되었고 많은 과학자를 놀라게 했다.
bad: The results published last year, and they surprised many scientists.
The results was published last year, and they surprised many scientists.
The results were publish last year, and they surprised many scientists.

cz.st: The results ___ published last year, and they surprised many scientists.

items.rule: 결과(results)는 복수이고 발표되는 대상이므로 수동태 were published를 써요.

items.good: The program aims to reduce waste, save energy and protect wildlife.
items.ko: 그 프로그램은 쓰레기를 줄이고 에너지를 아끼며 야생 동물을 보호하는 것을 목표로 한다.
bad: The program aims to reduce waste, saving energy and protect wildlife.
The program aims to reduce waste, save energy and protecting wildlife.
The program aims to reducing waste, save energy and protect wildlife.

cz.st: The program aims to reduce waste, ___ energy and protect wildlife.

items.rule: 나열되는 항목은 같은 형태로 맞춰야 해요(병렬 구조). to reduce, save, protect가 모두 동사원형이에요.

items.good: Despite being expensive, the device sold well.
items.ko: 비쌌음에도 불구하고 그 기기는 잘 팔렸다.
bad: Despite it was expensive, the device sold well.
Despite of being expensive, the device sold well.
Despite expensive, the device sold well.

cz.st: Despite ___ expensive, the device sold well.

items.rule: Despite 뒤에는 명사나 동명사가 오고, 절(주어+동사)이 바로 오지 않아요. of를 붙이지도 않아요.

items.good: Many animals, such as owls and bats, hunt at night.
items.ko: 올빼미와 박쥐 같은 많은 동물이 밤에 사냥한다.
bad: Many animals, such owls and bats, hunt at night.
Many animals, such as owls and bats, hunts at night.
Many animals, such as owls and bats, hunting at night.

cz.st: Many animals, such as owls and bats, ___ at night.

items.rule: 주어는 Many animals(복수)이고 such as ...는 삽입된 예시예요. 그래서 동사는 복수형 hunt를 써요.

items.good: A number of students were absent, but the number of absences was still small.
items.ko: 많은 학생이 결석했지만 결석 횟수는 여전히 적었다.
bad: A number of students was absent, but the number of absences was still small.
A number of students were absent, but the number of absences were still small.
A number of student were absent, but the number of absences was still small.

cz.st: A number of students were absent, but the number of absences ___ still small.

items.rule: a number of + 복수명사는 복수 취급이고, the number of + 복수명사는 '수' 자체가 주어이므로 단수 취급해요.

items.good: If the trend continues, the lake will be dry within a decade.
items.ko: 이 추세가 계속되면 호수는 십 년 안에 말라 버릴 것이다.
bad: If the trend will continue, the lake will be dry within a decade.
If the trend continued, the lake will be dry within a decade.
If the trend continues, the lake is dry within a decade.

cz.st: If the trend ___, the lake will be dry within a decade.

items.rule: 실현 가능성이 있는 조건문은 if절에 현재시제, 주절에 will을 써요. if절에는 will을 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: The author supports teaching skills rather than memorizing facts.
items.ko: 필자는 사실을 외우기보다 기술을 가르치는 것을 지지한다.
bad: The author supports teaching skills rather memorizing facts.
The author supports to teach skills rather than memorizing facts.
The author supports teaching skills instead than memorizing facts.

cz.st: The author supports teaching skills rather than ___ facts.

items.rule: rather than은 앞뒤를 같은 형태로 연결해요. teaching과 짝이 되도록 memorizing을 써요. support는 동명사를 목적어로 취해요.
